summary: Route canonical product_changed events through commerce-sync with tenant-scoped mapping, provider-native status translation and idempotent ProductWriter receipts.

impacts.evidence: Canonical product reads and product mappings use the event organization/workspace scope.
No new personal data is persisted or emitted.
No public endpoint or request shape changes.
The existing product_changed.v1 envelope and payload remain unchanged.
The existing ProductWriter SDK interface is reused unchanged.
Existing product mappings and local receipts are reused.
Account capabilities are rechecked and provider credentials remain callback scoped.
products.write remains a write-sensitive capability and explicit outbound policy is required.
Validated applied/duplicate outcomes are recorded in sync_local_receipts.
Product create retries reconcile by connector SKU/idempotency behavior before receipt commit.
Outbound calls use the existing host-mediated connector transport.
Transient errors remain on Kafka retry topics and permanent failures on the DLQ.
Disabling the policy or account capability stops product writes without migration.
Worker routing, status translation and generated runtime support tests cover the new path.
